reason: 让用户指定规划者和三个档位的执行者，并读取、核对、填入模型。新增配置键 planner：身份按 --planner、环境变量、MCP 客户端名判定，都识别不出时按配置处理；配置了规划者而调用者是另一个 agent 时 relay_dispatch 以 planner-mismatch 拒绝。新增 roles set 一条命令写入规划者、plannerProfiles 和三个档位的 执行者:模型@强度，规划者自己的模型写进它的配置（默认用户级）。新增模型目录模块（models、hostconfig、yaml-lite，归属待定，先记为未映射）：codex 用 app-server 的 model/list 获取并严格核对模型和推理强度；claude 用官方别名，有 API 密钥时补充 /v1/models，只检查格式；dsh 读 --dump-config 或 settings.yaml 的 provider 模型列表并核对。models set-default 改各 agent 的默认模型：只改 codex config.toml 顶层的 model 行、claude settings.json 的 model/effortLevel、dsh settings.yaml 的 agent-default-model；改前备份并显示改动，支持 --dry-run，执行者角色拒绝。dsh 档位带模型时，派发要求 dsh 当前默认模型一致，否则以 model-mismatch 拒绝。AGENTS.md 增加两条规则；relay-config 与 agenthub-relay 两个 skill 更新；.claude-plugin/plugin.json 只改版本号为 0.3.0。验证：新增模型、配置读写、YAML 子集和规划者不符的测试，原有 86 项测试不改断言通过。

en.reason: Let the user name the planner and the executor of each of the three tiers, and read, verify and fill in models. A new planner setting: identity comes from --planner, the environment variable or the MCP client name, and from the setting when none of them identifies the caller; with a planner configured, relay_dispatch refuses a different identified caller with planner-mismatch. A new roles set command writes the planner, plannerProfiles and executor:model@effort for each tier in one step, and writes the planner's own model into that agent's settings (user level by default). A new model catalog (models, hostconfig, yaml-lite; ownership to be decided, unmapped for now): codex models come from app-server model/list and models and efforts are checked exactly; claude uses its documented aliases, adds /v1/models when an API key is present, and is checked by format only; dsh models come from --dump-config or settings.yaml providers and are checked against them. models set-default changes an agent's default model: only the top-level model lines of codex config.toml, model/effortLevel in claude settings.json and agent-default-model in dsh settings.yaml, with a backup, a shown diff and --dry-run, refused in the executor role. A dsh tier with a model requires dsh's current default to match at dispatch, otherwise model-mismatch. AGENTS.md gains two rules; the relay-config and agenthub-relay skills are updated; .claude-plugin/plugin.json changes only its version, to 0.3.0. Verification: new tests for models, settings writes, the YAML subset and planner mismatch; the existing 86 tests pass unchanged.
